title: explorerComparison
responsibility: Compares the two sides of an entity's evidence: the scenarios covering a unit, their united entries and why the sides are not like for like.

inputs.name: covering.detail
inputs.description: The revision whose registry is read; null when it is not available.

inputs.name: united.now
inputs.description: The entries of the first side.

inputs.name: united.was
inputs.description: The entries of the second side.

inputs.name: merged.now
inputs.description: The scenario as the first side declares it.

inputs.name: merged.was
inputs.description: The same scenario on the other side, if it has one.

inputs.name: incomparable.before
inputs.description: The earlier side of the comparison.

inputs.name: incomparable.after
inputs.description: The later side of the comparison.

inputs.name: incomparable.unit
inputs.description: The id of the unit compared.

outputs.name: covering
outputs.description: The scenarios that cover the unit, each with the states that show it; empty without a revision.

outputs.name: united
outputs.description: Every entry once: those of the first list, then those only the second has.

outputs.name: merged
outputs.description: The scenario with the states, viewports and evidence of both sides, so what one dropped stays.

outputs.name: incomparable
outputs.description: The reasons the sides are not like for like, such as other profiles, viewport sizes or tests; empty when they are.
